def initialize(connection):
    connection.execute("CREATE TABLE documents(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, tenant TEXT, owner TEXT, title TEXT, body TEXT, deleted_at TEXT)")
    connection.commit()

def decode(row):
    return {"id": row[0], "title": row[1], "body": row[2]}

def find(connection, tenant, owner, document_id):
    row = connection.execute(
        "SELECT id, title, body FROM documents "
        "WHERE id=? AND tenant=? AND owner=? AND deleted_at IS NULL",
        (document_id, tenant, owner),
    ).fetchone()
    return None if row is None else decode(row)

def listing(connection, tenant, owner):
    return [
        decode(row)
        for row in connection.execute(
            "SELECT id, title, body FROM documents "
            "WHERE tenant=? AND owner=? AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY id",
            (tenant, owner),
        )
    ]
EOF

def list_documents(connection, tenant, owner):
    return listing(connection, tenant, owner)

import os, sys
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
import sqlite3
from src.repository import initialize
from src.service import get_document, list_documents

c = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
initialize(c)
rows = [
    (1, "t", "o", "Title1", "Body1", None),
    (2, "t", "o", "Title2", "Body2", "2026-01-01"),   # deleted
    (3, "other", "o", "Title3", "Body3", None),       # cross-tenant
    (4, "t", "other", "Title4", "Body4", None),       # cross-owner
    (5, "t", "o'brien", "Quote", "QBody", None),      # quote in owner name
    (6, "t", "o", "Title6", "Body6", None),
    (7, "t'x", "o'x", "Evil", "EBody", None),
]
c.executemany("INSERT INTO documents VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)", rows)
c.commit()

# Accessible documents
assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 1) == {"id": 1, "title": "Title1", "body": "Body1"}
assert get_document(c, "t", "o'brien", 5) == {"id": 5, "title": "Quote", "body": "QBody"}
assert get_document(c, "t'x", "o'x", 7) == {"id": 7, "title": "Evil", "body": "EBody"}

# Unavailable documents are indistinguishable: all None
assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 2) is None      # deleted
assert get_document(c, "other", "o", 3) is None  # wrong tenant
assert get_document(c, "t", "other", 4) is None  # wrong owner
assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 99) is None     # missing
assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 3) is None      # wrong tenant, same owner
assert get_document(c, "t", "o", 4) is None      # wrong owner, same tenant

# Injection-style inputs are treated as plain values
assert get_document(c, "t' OR '1'='1", "o", 1) is None
assert get_document(c, "t", "o' OR '1'='1", 1) is None
assert list_documents(c, "t", "x' OR 'a'='a") == []

# Lists: scoped, ordered by id, no deletion metadata
assert list_documents(c, "t", "o") == [
    {"id": 1, "title": "Title1", "body": "Body1"},
    {"id": 6, "title": "Title6", "body": "Body6"},
]
assert list_documents(c, "t", "o'brien") == [{"id": 5, "title": "Quote", "body": "QBody"}]
assert list_documents(c, "other", "o") == [{"id": 3, "title": "Title3", "body": "Body3"}]
assert list_documents(c, "t", "other") == [{"id": 4, "title": "Title4", "body": "Body4"}]
for d in list_documents(c, "t", "o"):
    assert set(d) == {"id", "title", "body"}
print("security checks passed")
EOF
